tagline: Your local STIHL dealer and service centre
heroSubheading: We provide the full STIHL range and expert service.
aboutHtml:
We've been serving the Selwyn District for many years. Stephen and Simon run STIHL SHOP Rolleston as your local dealer for the full STIHL range, plus a proper service centre with certified technicians.

We stock equipment ready to take home, and we keep our workshop fully equipped to handle service and repairs. Whether it's your STIHL or another brand, we'll get it running properly. When you need servicing, we'll lend you battery-powered gear to try while yours is being worked on.

Come and see what we've got. Our team has real experience, and we'll give you straight advice on what works for your place. We're open seven days a week.
servicesIntro: Expert service and repairs for STIHL and all major outdoor power brands.
